registryCustodian: National Chief Surveyor General cadastral ArcGIS service evidenced; Steve Tshwete Local Municipality geographical-information page identified but municipal parcel API not qualified.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Afrikaans discovery queries were performed. Official national CSG cadastral REST service and official Steve Tshwete municipal geographical-information page were identified. The CSG service returned three safe Middelburg-area Erven polygons in a bounded anonymous query.
requestOutcomes: Service configuration and layer schema returned over HTTPS with TLS verification enabled. A bounded EPSG:4326 envelope query against Erven returned three polygon geometries and native identifiers. Additional layer probes included a zero-feature result and query errors; neither is treated as cadastral absence.

schemaAndCrs.parcelSchema: ArcGIS polygon Feature Layer, Erven layer 2
schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: Native WKID 4148; response requested in EPSG:4326
schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: PRCL_KEY is a native field returned by the official Erven layer; no synthetic key was created.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [-25.7630669966059, 29.4394487589585] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not moved.
The envelope sample proves nearby public geometry, not citywide or countrywide completeness.
National agency service evidence does not prove a local municipal registry endpoint.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate, or title fields were requested or retained.
No retained GeoJSON sample is included; raw response and service metadata are under ignored tmp/.
Independent serial review is required before adapter/runtime qualification.

qualification.reason: Anonymous safe ID-plus-geometry response was verified, but citywide coverage and runtime adapter suitability remain unqualified.

uncertainty: The public national service is usable for bounded research, but broader coverage, update cadence, municipal scope, and production adapter behavior remain unverified.
